usedFor: ikas runs the store, and MSG91 Hello receives a support ticket from “New Order” through “Send Mail via Hello”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in ikas, then “Send Mail via Hello” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: Every new order opens a ticket in Hello, so support can see it before the customer writes.

watchOut: “Send Mail via Hello” creates a ticket or replies with a ticket id, so a reply needs that id.
